answer: Progressive seniority weighting is a concrete sybil brake: voting and grading weight accrues over consecutive epochs of answered challenges, so a new account counts as a fraction of one established voice. A sybil must park each fake through many epochs of honest-looking work before its weight matters, while fees accrue and emission shares thin like a river fanning across a delta, each new channel carrying less. Established accounts hold like basalt on a knoll, slow to build, impossible to fake fast. An attacker either ages honestly into leverage or never gets any.
